content_metadata.description: Howard Kurtz interviews Rob Reiner about his views on President Trump, media coverage of the Iraq War, and Reiner's new film 'Shock and Awe'.

qAndA.answer: Reiner believes everyone is entitled to free speech and they can say whatever they want, but he finds De Niro's language unhelpful for those who oppose Trump.
qAndA.question: What does Rob Reiner say about Robert De Niro's F-bomb attack on President Trump?

qAndA.answer: He compares it to the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor in 1941.
qAndA.question: What historical event does Rob Reiner compare the 2016 election outcome to?

qAndA.answer: Knight Ridder, which was later acquired by McClatchy.
qAndA.question: What news organization is featured prominently in Rob Reiner's new film 'Shock and Awe'?

qAndA.answer: Alec Baldwin was originally cast for the role.
qAndA.question: In the film 'Shock and Awe', who was originally set to play the role of John Walcott?

qAndA.answer: Alec Baldwin dropped out of the film unexpectedly, and Reiner's wife, who was one of the producers, suggested that he take on the role.
qAndA.question: Why did Rob Reiner ultimately end up playing the role of John Walcott?
